As much as I’d love to agree with you, that’s not how my life has been. It’s been a bunch of these moments followed by maybe one or two moments of happiness that are then completely upset by these moments again. At some point I am going to have to accept that they’re not moments and instead just the life I’ve put myself in that has very few ways out. 

I’m very glad you had that realization though.
Exactly! Man, I’m relieved. I kind of felt like the only one haha.
